name: Exact calculator
about: Example plugin: copy this folder to make your own. Does maths exactly (small models are bad at arithmetic).
description: Calculates a maths expression exactly: + - * / ** % ( ), sqrt, sin, cos, tan, log, pi, e. Use it for any arithmetic or percentages.
instructions: Write the calculation as one Python maths expression. Percentages: 17.5% of 2340 -> 2340 * 17.5 / 100. Square root: sqrt(2). Example: {"expression": "(12.5 + 7) * 3"}
